method: independent labeled whole-head and eye-direction review of the exact final bytes, corroborated by fresh three-reviewer blind A/B consensus
review_notes: The v11 edge-color cleanup preserves the v10 alpha channel, silhouette, registration, and motion geometry exactly.
Three fresh blind reviewers unanimously classified all 28 A/B cells, including both cardinal hard gates; no cell was ambiguous or unconfirmed.

directions.reason: Gold pupils sit high in both eye openings and the chin is lifted while the feet and ring remain planted.
The raised gaze begins the clockwise move from straight up toward viewer-right.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Pupils, nose, and facial plane begin shifting toward the long white braid on viewer-right.
directions.vertical_evidence: Pupils remain high and the chin remains lifted relative to neutral.

directions.reason: The head and eyes form a readable upper-right three-quarter view.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The nose and visible eye advance farther toward viewer-right.
directions.vertical_evidence: The eye line stays above level and the lower eyelids open upward.

directions.reason: The pose approaches the right cardinal without dropping below the horizontal axis.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The face presents a strong viewer-right profile cue.
directions.vertical_evidence: Pupils and brow line retain a slight upward bias before 090.

directions.reason: Pupils, nose, and face point level toward the white braid and viewer-right edge; the hard blind pair passed unanimously.
The ordered loop moves below the right cardinal into the lower-right quadrant.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The face and visible eye preserve a viewer-right profile bias.
directions.vertical_evidence: Pupils and eyelids move below level and the chin begins to tuck.

directions.reason: The bowed head remains clearly oriented into the lower-right quadrant.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose and facial plane continue to point viewer-right.
directions.vertical_evidence: The eyelids lower and the chin tucks farther than at 112.5.

directions.reason: The final first-row pose is strongly lowered with a remaining rightward cue before the down cardinal.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The bowed nose and facial surface retain a small viewer-right bias.
directions.vertical_evidence: Closed lowered lids and a deeply tucked chin make the downward component dominant.

directions.reason: Chin and eyelids face straight down without meaningful horizontal bias; the hard blind pair passed unanimously.
The lowered gaze begins moving from straight down toward the handset side.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose and facial plane shift toward the black-hair and purple-handset side on viewer-left.
directions.vertical_evidence: Closed lowered lids and tucked chin preserve the downward emphasis.

directions.reason: The head and eyes form a readable lower-left three-quarter view.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The face is visibly displaced toward the handset and viewer-left edge.
directions.vertical_evidence: The eye line remains low and the chin stays bowed.

directions.reason: The pose approaches the left cardinal while retaining a downward tilt.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The nose and facial plane read strongly viewer-left.
directions.vertical_evidence: The half-lidded eye line remains below level before 270.

directions.reason: Both pupils and the face point level toward the purple handset and viewer-left edge; the hard blind pair passed unanimously.
The ordered loop rises from the left cardinal into the upper-left quadrant.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Eyes, nose, and facial plane remain directed toward viewer-left.
directions.vertical_evidence: The pupils and eye line rise above the level established at 270.

directions.reason: The head and eyes form a clear upper-left three-quarter view.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The nose and visible eye retain a viewer-left bias.
directions.vertical_evidence: Pupils and chin lift farther toward the top of the loop.

directions.reason: The final pose approaches straight up while preserving a small leftward cue and flowing back to 000.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The facial plane retains a slight viewer-left bias near the loop seam.
directions.vertical_evidence: Wide raised eyes and lifted chin make the upward component dominant.
